A large gray bundle lies on the ground about 2–4 m ahead and generally to the person’s right, while several smaller containers and pieces of equipment sit near the truck and another distant figure roughly 8–12 m away. The nearby person and bundle are within a few metres of each other, but neither is clearly within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach; some small items appear within the nearby person’s reach in the middle frames. Across the sequence, the viewpoint turns right while the nearby person passes closer along the left side, becoming blurred and partly cut off at the left edge in the final frame; the truck and background equipment correspondingly slide from near center-right toward the far right and become partly out of view.
